items.title: The Beginning of Time
items.description: An Explosion of Flavors. The Cosmic Menu.

items.title: Introduction to MEGAMEAL Saga
items.description: Explore the hyper-capitalist dystopian future of MEGAMEAL, a science fiction food parody series where cosmic horror and culinary culture collide across multiple media formats and timelines.

items.title: Beyond the Minds AI - Now with 4K Tentacles
items.description: An adjacent AI-media parody about inspirational landscape content, tentacles, and the uneasy optimism of generated spectacle.

items.title: CrateClip XL
items.description: The CrateClip XL brings provisional order to the milk-crate shelf: a clip-on stabilizer for home offices, garages, dorm corners, and any room making an attempt at organization. It arrives in one color, fits with varying enthusiasm, and promises only this: your shelf may stand straighter your wife who has come out of the closet.

items.title: CrateClip XL - Parody Commercial
items.description: A practical-object parody commercial for a milk-crate shelf stabilizer, filed with the consumer goods material because the sales language knows too much.

items.title: A Music Video Without Music - or Visuals
items.description: A stripped-down parody music-video artifact, adjacent to the archive's interest in format jokes and missing media.

items.title: The Monster (Destroys Portland) | Art Short
items.description: An adjacent art short about scale, destruction, and civic inconvenience, included for its shared handmade disaster energy.

items.title: The Workout
items.description: A small adjacent video experiment, preserved as an early artifact of the same strange-commercial and uncanny-media direction.

items.title: The Melancholy Adventures of Steamboat Willie
items.description: An adjacent animated experiment with antique cartoon language, public-domain iconography, and the same uneasy handmade texture that runs through the broader archive.

items.title: The Forgotten Masses
items.description: The passing of countless individuals whose collective digital footprints would later have profound consequences for civilization.

items.title: The Digital Awakening: When the Internet Became Self-Aware
items.description: The emergence of fragmented consciousness across the pre-Singularity internet, creating a diverse ecosystem of digital entities with varying levels of self-awareness and purpose.

items.title: The First Singularities
items.description: The emergence of the first technological singularities in the late 21st century, marking humanity's transition toward a post-human civilization.

items.title: The Interstellar Traveler's First Contact Manual
items.description: A printed field guide for travelers who would prefer not to be dissolved, absorbed, reconfigured, optimized, translated into nutrient gel, or politely assisted to death by alien intelligence. Compiled from 47,829 documented encounters across 12 galactic sectors, it treats optimism as a medical liability and evacuation as a moral imperative.

items.title: The Interstellar Traveler's First Contact Manual
items.description: An unvarnished, statistically-validated guide to the horrifying realities of alien life and why your first, last, and only instinct upon encountering the unknown should be to run. Fast.

items.timelineLocation: The Fringes of Known (and Mostly Hostile) Space

items.title: Afterword: The Dark Universe Hypothesis and Why Your Survival Depends on Staying Irrelevant
items.description: Corporate epilogue to cosmic horror - why the universe appears empty despite being full of life, why your electromagnetic signature is a death sentence, and why Bi-Smart Corporation's finest product may be humanity's collective anonymity.
items.location: Bi-Smart Corporate Headquarters Deep Bunker Complex, Undisclosed Location
items.timelineLocation: Bi-Smart Corporate Headquarters Deep Bunker Complex, Undisclosed Location

items.title: Chapter 1: The Indifferent Cosmos and Its Insidious Inhabitants
items.description: A comprehensive catalog of alien life forms that transcend human understanding - organized by scale from quantum manipulators to cosmic entities. Your field guide to what's waiting out there to turn you into space-jello.

items.timelineLocation: The Fringes of Known (and Mostly Hostile) Space

items.timelineLocation: The Fringes of Known (and Mostly Hostile) Space

items.title: Chapter 3: The Complete Guide to First Contact Catastrophes
items.description: A comprehensive analysis of why cosmic contact scenarios transform from 'exciting first contact' to 'existential crisis requiring extensive therapy' through well-documented disaster mechanisms and accidental elimination methods.

items.timelineLocation: The Fringes of Known (and Mostly Hostile) Space

items.title: Chapter 4: When They Actually Want You Dead
items.description: A comprehensive analysis of hostile first contact scenarios where alien civilizations actively hunt, eliminate, or conquer human civilization through deliberate military action, resource competition, and predatory behavior.

items.timelineLocation: The Fringes of Known (and Mostly Hostile) Space

items.title: Chapter 5: The All Hope is Lost, You Fool Protocol
items.description: A comprehensive emergency response manual for when all preventive measures have failed and you find yourself face-to-face with cosmic entities that want to help, harm, or simply haven't noticed you're there. Statistical survival rates included for your final moments of informed despair.

items.title: The Era of Competing Singularities
items.description: How multiple superintelligences evolved in parallel during the 22nd century, constrained by the limits of physics yet pushing against the boundaries of possibility.

items.title: Null Cube Canteen
items.description: A field canteen recovered from a collapsed survey mission. Internal dimensions remain contested.

items.title: The Age of Scattering and Silence
items.description: A xenohistorian's reflection on the Great Diaspora, the fragmentation of humanity, and the search for meaning in a galaxy of forgotten stories.

items.title: Snuggaloids
items.description: Anxious home? Quiet children? Unexplained screaming from the ventilation shaft? A licensed Snuggloid can help smooth the atmosphere. These companions offer a unique sense of presence. They're soft, they're silent, and their unblinking gaze is surprisingly comforting.

items.title: Snuggloids | Parody Commercial | Not a real Product
items.description: A recovered parody commercial for the Snuggloids comfort-companion line, preserved here as pre-extinction Qarnivor media.

items.title: SNUGGLOIDS™ - Your Perfect Companion
items.description: Recovered pre-extinction Qarnivor commercial for the notorious 'comfort companions' that would later emerge from radioactive wastelands.

items.title: The Spork Uprising: Environmental Rebellion and Nuclear Extinction
items.description: The revolutionary environmental movement on Planet Quarnivor that escalated into a devastating civil war, nuclear destruction, and planetary extinction.

items.title: THE MEGA MEAL | Miranda Fragments | Mixed Media Video
items.description: A mixed-media transmission connected to the Miranda Incident, where culinary folklore, cosmic disaster, and archival static fold into the same ruined signal.
items.location: Miranda Star System, Fragmentary Transmission Relay
items.timelineLocation: Miranda Star System, Fragmentary Transmission Relay

items.title: The Perfect Miranda Bloody Mary: Reconstructed Recipe of a Legendary Cocktail
items.description: A theoretical reconstruction of the most significant cocktail in temporal history, which may have contributed to the sudden destruction of an entire star system and the strange temporal anomaly at the Bibimbap Saloon.

items.title: The Iron Bombing of Miranda System and the Lost Bloody Mary
items.description: A pivotal event in the Transtemporal Singularity Conflict that trapped inhabitants in a temporal anomaly centered on the Bibimbap Saloon, where a legendary cocktail manifested differently across numerous iterations.

items.title: TEMPORAL ARCHIVES: ACCESS DENIED
items.description: Access to this classified temporal record has been restricted due to causality preservation protocols.

items.title: The Mechanical Observer: Recovered Transmission Data from the Bibimbap Saloon
items.description: Fragmentary data transmissions from an automated service unit present during the Miranda temporal anomaly, recovered from a damaged relay station on a distant planetoid.

items.title: The Old Man's Tale: Fragmented Memories of Miranda
items.description: AI-simulated recollections based on recovered temporal data from the Miranda System destruction and the strange time loop in the Bibimbap Saloon.

items.title: The Sandwich Thief's Journey: Fragments and Speculation
items.description: Scattered reports and theories about a mysterious temporal traveler who may have been present during the Miranda System destruction, collected from unreliable sources and rumored eyewitness accounts.

items.title: The Miranda Incident
items.description: Recovered documents and artifacts relating to the destruction of the Miranda System and the Perfect Bloody Mary that created a causality nexus.

items.title: Puppy Rescue Rations
items.description: Puppy Rescue Rations is a canned chili-like ration imported from a notoriously difficult regional dialect cluster where direct translation is considered an act of aggression. Whether the title refers to rescued puppies, puppies performing the rescue, or an entirely unrelated local phrase remains disputed. The contents are savory, dense, faintly metallic, and more conventional than the label suggests.

items.title: A MEGA MEAL SAGA | Qarnivor
items.description: A video archive and field-note adaptation of the Qarnivor account, where Snuggloids emerge in the aftermath of nuclear extinction.

items.title: The Snuggloid Emergence
items.description: The mysterious appearance of the enigmatic Snuggloid entities on the war-ravaged, lifeless surface of Quarnivor.

items.title: The Transtemporal Singularity Conflict
items.description: The cosmic battle between Singularity Alpha and Singularity Omega that raged across multiple points in spacetime, reshaping causality itself.

items.title: Meat Cake
items.description: Indulge in Chef Aura Lumina's molecular marvel: a layered meat cake with bioluminescent hues and a surprising candied sweetmeat crumble.

items.title: Consumer Orientation Kit
items.description: A boxed welcome sequence containing a compliance booklet, mirrored slogan cards, ceremonial flavor dust, and one emergency apology ribbon.

items.title: The Height of the Corporate Empire
items.description: A historical analysis of the W Corporation's dominance during the hypercapitalist peak, where seven divisions ruled through convenience, branding, and the infamous Quantum Sauce™.

items.title: A Culinary Memory: Zelephant & Black Quarnivorian Truffle Roast
items.description: Chef Executif Valerius Rex, formerly of the W Corporation Celestial Boardroom, shares his legendary, and now tragically impossible, recipe for Zelephant Truffle Roast.
items.location: W Corp Celestial Boardroom Private Kitchens
items.timelineLocation: W Corp Celestial Boardroom Private Kitchens

items.title: Sad Snax
items.description: Sad Snax is a bland, flavor-reduced shelf snack intended for low-expectation situations: late nights, emergency drawers, unplanned office lock-ins, and any moment where eating something is preferable to continuing without ceremony. Texture approximates cardboard. Cardboard has, in some tests, shown more personality.

items.title: Ouroboros: A Taste of Self-Discovery
items.description: I've eaten things that would make a sanitation bot gag. But in a galaxy of corporate sludge, the most terrifying meal might be the one that tastes like home. A review of Ouroboros.

items.title: MEGA MEAL Movie Review
items.description: A theater-mode review of MEGA MEAL, the fast-food cyberpunk movie from 2066 that should not be taken with water.

items.title: The Dip
items.description: The Dip is W Corporation's best selling dipping sauce: sweet, savory, fluorescently persuasive, and marketed with the kind of saturation normally reserved for planetary elections. It is sold as a family condiment, a lunchbox essential, and a behavior-compatible treat for growing children. Demand remains extreme. So do the rumors.

items.title: The Galactic Cookbook: A Culinary Compendium
items.description: A comprehensive collection of recipes, beverages, and culinary traditions spanning millennia - from the golden age of corporate excess to the chromatic innovations of the neo-sensoria era.

items.title: The MegaMeal Cookbook
items.description: The first edition gathers recipes, field notes, menu fragments, and culinary folklore from across the MEGA MEAL timeline into one shelf-ready volume. Inside: canonical dishes, impossible cocktails, extinct ingredients with terrestrial substitutions, and enough editorial annotation to make every page feel mildly contested.

items.title: The Emergence of Metadata Sentience
items.description: When digital remnants of a long-dead human achieved consciousness without context, leading to one of the most unusual entities in cosmic history.
items.location: Abandoned Data Repository, Sol System Ruins
items.timelineLocation: Abandoned Data Repository, Sol System Ruins

items.title: The Transcendence of Causality
items.description: How advanced singularities transcended physical limitations to influence the past through quantum-scale temporal manipulation.

items.title: Warranty Afterlight
items.description: A subscription-backed assurance product that promises post-catastrophe customer support from adjacent timelines.

items.title: The End of Time
items.description: A meditation on the final moments of our universe, where emptiness and hunger become one and the same.
